Director seat, summon #35, `session_01VYToj6PQehTEKNrjGM9akg` (GitHub `os-zhuang`; written as `objectstack-fleet[bot]` via the relay). Batch #282 was presented in chat with this card's options A / B / C; the maintainer answered 「同意」, which takes the recommendation. Freshness gate: the body (no comments), #15206, ADR-0131 D6 / D10 / D13 and the #21835 ruling 6005722623 were re-read before this record. Thread-read: none on this card.

## The ruling

**A.** At the v18 upgrade the migration ceremony (C7, #15211) carries every organization-layer withdrawal of a public form to the environment layer. **Conflict rule, fail-closed:** on a deployment with more than one organization, a form any organization withdrew is withdrawn at the environment layer. A withdrawal is customer-written state, not a mirror, so D10 sanctions no deletion of it; and the organization layer retires whole (D13), so no special read survives for it. Withdrawals are `view`-type organization-scoped overlay rows, so this is the fail-closed sub-case of batch #282 item 4 (#22011) inside the same promotion.

**Pin owed with C7:** a public form withdrawn before the upgrade is refused at the anonymous intake doors after it, on both kernels.

**Not taken:** B (the organization-layer withdrawals lapse and the forms reopen on upgrade day, silently; a security regression); C (a kept organization-layer read for withdrawals alone, which leaves the retirement incomplete).

## Execution

- C7 (#15211): the migration plan gains the "withdrawal promotion" category with the any-organization rule and the pin above.
- C5 (#15206): no `anonymousFormIntakeOrgScopeRefusal`-class read is kept past the retirement.
- Pointers recorded on #15206 and #15211. This card closes `completed` in this act.
